gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
gaps.sentence: I think it's only ___ Jemma becomes a famous model.
gaps.explanation: 'It's only a matter of time before' means it will definitely happen eventually.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: After a year in Paris, the pace of life feels normal to her.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to + noun/-ing = become accustomed to; present perfect for present result.

gaps.lead: I wish I had never told her the secret.
gaps.explanation: wish + past perfect ≈ shouldn't have + participle.

gaps.lead: Barbara's parents were certain that she would be a great tennis player.
gaps.sentence: Barbara's parents were ___ that she would be a great tennis player.

gaps.lead: I think learning to use a typewriter is a waste of time.
gaps.sentence: I can't ___ how to use a typewriter.
gaps.explanation: 'A waste of time' becomes 'can't see the point in/of doing it'.
